This philosophy promotes the belief that you are divine, that you can manifest anything your heart desires—but God’s Word tells a very different story. Jesus said we are to pray according to God’s will, not our own selfish ambitions. If it’s hard for a rich man to enter the Kingdom, why would God “bless” us with endless wealth? Satan offered Jesus the kingdoms of this world… so what spirit is really behind the promise of prosperity?

This seductive message has crept into even Christian churches—but it’s time to uncover the truth. The Law of Attraction is nothing new—it’s the serpent’s lie from Eden: “You shall be as gods.”
